$comment: Per-agent model recommendation appended to each generated command's description. Keyed by target, then command name. Claude Code's own hint is NOT here — it lives inline in .claude/commands/*.md, which Claude Code reads directly. Codex is absent by design: it ships no repo command files, so its recommendation is README-only. Each agent exposes a different model catalog, so a hint is only ever emitted into that agent's own command files.
$notation: Every hint reads cheapest → most expensive, always in that direction. Bold marks where to start: bold on the left means the right-hand model is the escalation; bold on the right means the left-hand model is the budget drop.
